resources.string: Choose a saved profile, then select its rules. Destinations map to this app’s Proxy, Direct or Block; outbound settings, DNS and hosts are not copied. Nothing is persisted until Save.

Added %1$d rules, skipped %2$d exact duplicates. Use Save to apply.
Use ordinary profile routing; in Live Routing, disable shared Core Routing without importing member rules. Keep the draft for later.
Replaces the entire profile routing object, discarding its rules, balancers and strategy. Managed rules still apply.
Profile rules first, then Core Routing; exact duplicates are skipped. Core Routing settings override matching profile settings.

Profile only uses ordinary profile routing; in Live Routing it disables shared Core Routing, never imports member rules. Core Routing only replaces the entire profile routing object, including unique rules, balancers and domainStrategy. Combine keeps profile rules first and appends Core Routing rules, skipping only exact duplicates. Managed rules still apply; Live Routing keeps priority. Proxy uses the selected primary outbound or Live Routing default group. Import copies selected rules into a draft, not DNS or hosts. Save applies the selected mode and draft.
The draft changed during import. Try importing again.
